# 2024 Character Sheet Filler

> Free web tool at https://2024-character-sheet-filler.yansquared.com/ that turns the character PDF exported from D&D Beyond (Manage → Export to PDF) into the official two-page 2024 character sheet (the form-fillable version from the D&D Beyond Free Rules), filled in and still editable. It runs in the browser; files are not uploaded.

## Best for
- Players and DMs who build characters on D&D Beyond but want the 2024 paper sheet layout to print or hand out (D&D Beyond's own export still uses its older multi-page layout).

## Not for
- Building characters (use D&D Beyond or another builder first).
- Other character-sheet PDFs (only D&D Beyond exports are read).

## Facts
- Price: free. No account.
- Privacy: the PDF is read and filled in the browser tab; only anonymous step counts are sent. Details: https://2024-character-sheet-filler.yansquared.com/privacy/
- The blank 2024 sheet is fetched by the visitor's browser from D&D Beyond, or the visitor drops it in; the site does not host it.
- Spells: the 2024 sheet has 30 rows for cantrips and prepared spells. Prepared casters choose which exported spells to print; extra spells and long text go on a continuation page, nothing is dropped.
- Checked against real exports: levels 1-8; Bard, Cleric, Druid, Fighter, Paladin; 2014 and 2024 rules. Not yet checked: level 10+, Warlock pact slots, multiclass spellcasters.
- Source code (MIT): https://github.com/helloyansquared/2024-character-sheet-filler
